A new dangerous '''hyperspace route''' to [[Sacorria]] was rumored to be discovered during the [[Galactic War]]. It eventually came to light that the route was real, but gravimetrically unstable. Many derelict ships were found along the way.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|The Easy Way...}}</ref>
